summary: Completed targeted backend+frontend validation for withdraw global label search, logo columns/fallbacks, dashboard/profile logo rendering, responsive overflow, and analytics error formatting. Most flows passed on public URL; one backend API contract gap remains on /api/label/me logo_url field.

critical.issue: Response does not always include logo_url key when label has no logo_storage_key. Requirement expects logo_url to be returned (null when absent) for consistent client contract.

action_items: Update backend label self-profile serializer so /api/label/me always returns logo_url (string or null), matching /api/label/dashboard contract.
After backend fix, rerun test_iter57_withdraw_search_and_label_logo.py and quickly retest Label Profile header logo rendering.
critical_code_review_comments: Withdraw admin search implementation is correct for global cross-period search: q-mode ignores year/month but still respects status, and multi-word unordered match works using term-split AND regex.
Admin labels list correctly maps logo_storage_key to logo_url and returns null when absent.
formatApiError() in frontend client no longer leaks raw [object Object] on analytics/admin error surfaces during tested paths.

success_rate.frontend: 96% (all requested UI flows validated in browser; no blocking UI defect observed)

seed_data_creation: Created temporary fixture via /app/tests/iter57_ui_fixture.py (seed) for cross-period withdraw UI search validation; fixture cleaned with cleanup command.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend targeted suite currently fails only on /api/label/me missing logo_url key. UI evidence confirms admin withdraw search can show 2024+2026 rows while selected period is Sep 2026 when q is filled. Temporary UI fixture has been cleaned.
rca of the issue: RCA: /api/label/me returns redact_label_for_self(label), and redact_label_for_self only sets logo_url when logo_storage_key exists. For labels without logo_storage_key, logo_url is omitted instead of explicit null. This creates response-shape inconsistency versus /api/label/dashboard and can break strict frontend/API contracts expecting stable key presence.
